connector.name: OneQAZ Trading Intelligence
connector.registryDescription: Live market data, signals, positions, and macro analysis for crypto, KR stocks, and US stocks.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.oneqaz.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package oneqaz-trading-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the wnsod account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
